summary: Only source found is the Forest Fire Lookout Association register, which lists a Thunder Lake tower in Oneida County as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone in the Forest Fire Lookout Association register; no other source found

evidence.supports: the register lists a tower at Thunder Lake in Oneida County, marked gone, with its coordinates

notes_for_editor: Register-only record. Searches (two) and page reads (about six across Thunder Lake and Tripoli) found no build date, staffing, fate detail or site description, and no state, county or register page for this tower beyond the list row. The story is well under the 120-word floor because the register row is the only evidence; consider holding it back until a source turns up. The register's own page does not link a detail page for gone towers, so none was available to read.
